what: Frame time of bh_animation_page.html measured in real time through the Chrome DevTools protocol (headless Chrome, ANGLE D3D11, 1440 x 900 window). median_ms is the median interval after a drawn frame over the last 60 frames, read from the page's own readout. The display caps at 120 Hz, so 8.3 ms means the frame finished inside one refresh.
